batch_target_bytes.title: Snapshot batch target bytes
batch_target_bytes.description: Target retained decoded MySQL row heap per snapshot batch. The reader may include one final indivisible row after crossing the target; max_row_bytes separately bounds its wire packet, while decoded Row/Value overhead is measured and accounted from actual allocations.

max_row_bytes.title: Maximum snapshot row packet bytes
max_row_bytes.description: Exact mysql_async client max_allowed_packet for one MySQL wire packet. Decoded Row/Value overhead is measured and accounted separately. Valid range: 1024..=1073741824 bytes.

read_protocol.title: Read protocol
read_protocol.description: MySQL wire protocol used for snapshot rows. Binary is the lossless measured high-throughput default. Text remains available for supported schemas, but discovery rejects FLOAT columns because MySQL text formatting cannot preserve every f32 value exactly.

replication.description: Configures row-based binary-log replication for stream and `batch_and_stream` deliveries.

server_id.title: Replica server ID
server_id.description: Unique non-zero MySQL replication client ID used to fence this binlog reader on the source server

max_events.title: Maximum transaction events
max_events.description: Maximum binlog events and decoded rows accepted in one transaction before failing closed; lower values bound memory more tightly

max_transaction_bytes.title: Maximum transaction bytes
max_transaction_bytes.description: Maximum encoded binlog bytes buffered for one transaction before failing closed

poll_interval_ms.title: Stream poll interval
poll_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between MySQL replication heartbeats and the maximum time a local read waits before yielding an empty batch; it must be shorter than the replication request timeout so an idle closed reader releases its connection-owned execution lock before reacquisition times out

bootstrap_timeout_ms.title: Replication request timeout
bootstrap_timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds for replication preflight, exact-boundary capture, stream startup, and stream shutdown requests

max_response_bytes.title: Maximum response bytes
max_response_bytes.description: Maximum accepted uncompressed body for one OpenSearch response

page_rows.title: Rows per search page
page_rows.description: Maximum documents returned by one sliced point-in-time request

read_concurrency.title: Parallel shard readers
read_concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous slice page requests per index

pit_keep_alive_ms.title: Point-in-time keep alive, ms
pit_keep_alive_ms.description: OpenSearch renews the coherent index PIT lifetime on every snapshot page request

retry_max_attempts.title: Retry maximum attempts
retry_max_attempts.description: Total attempts for one unchanged PIT operation before failing

max_response_bytes.title: Maximum response bytes
max_response_bytes.description: Maximum accepted uncompressed body for one OpenSearch response

routed_identity.title: Custom routing identity
routed_identity.description:
Controls custom-routed source documents. The default fails before any
request. `encode_identity` is an explicit, injective destination `_id`
transformation that preserves (`_id`, effective routing key) identity.

oneOf.title: Fail on custom routing
oneOf.description:
Reject custom-routed source documents because `OpenSearch` does not make
(`_id`, `_routing`) globally unique across shards.

oneOf.title: Encode the complete routed identity
oneOf.description:
Explicitly replace destination `_id` with a lossless encoding of the
complete (`_id`, effective routing key) source identity.

copy_to_format.title: COPY TO format
copy_to_format.description: PostgreSQL wire format used for snapshot COPY TO STDOUT

replication.description: Configures logical replication for stream and `batch_and_stream` deliveries.

bootstrap_timeout_ms.title: Replication bootstrap timeout
bootstrap_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for opening the replication session and exporting the exact slot snapshot

copy_from_format.title: COPY FROM format
copy_from_format.description: PostgreSQL wire format used for COPY FROM STDIN

batch_rows.title: Maximum block rows
batch_rows.description: Maximum number of rows requested in one ClickHouse result block

primary_key.title: Unique row key
primary_key.description:
Columns that the user guarantees identify one logical row uniquely.
`ClickHouse` sorting and primary keys do not enforce uniqueness, so the
connector never infers this contract from table metadata.

decode_threads.title: Parquet decode threads
decode_threads.description: Maximum number of Parquet row groups decoded concurrently

max_response_bytes.title: Maximum Parquet response bytes
max_response_bytes.description: Explicit memory safety limit for one compressed ClickHouse snapshot response

insert_concurrency.description:
Maximum number of concurrently active INSERTs. Values above one are an
explicit throughput choice; ordered delivery progress is still committed
only after the contiguous INSERT prefix completes.

insert_format.description:
Wire format used for INSERT payloads. Parquet and `ArrowStream` use the
`ClickHouse` HTTP endpoint and are stable, self-describing interchange
formats; Native uses the `ClickHouse` native TCP protocol.

format_threads.description: Number of `ClickHouse` threads available to decode one HTTP format body.

parquet_row_group_rows.description: Maximum rows in a Parquet row group produced for one HTTP INSERT.

async_insert.description:
Let `ClickHouse` coalesce concurrent native INSERTs server-side. Waiting
remains mandatory, so a successful response still means the buffered
data has reached the table rather than merely entering an async queue.

message_index.description: Zero-based index of a record inside one source message when framing yields multiple records

write_timestamp_ms.description: Source-reported message write time as Unix epoch milliseconds

S3JsonParserConfig.description: JSON parser configuration deserialized from the `json_parser:` block.

json_framing.description: How incoming message bytes frame JSON records.

JsonFramingMode.description: Record framing policy owned by the JSON parser.

ColumnMapping.description: Explicit `JSONPath` and JSON-to-Arrow conversion for one output column.

object_layout_version.description:
Version of the deterministic object key/payload/epoch contract. Keep
this pinned while uncommitted source data can replay.

max_epoch_buffers.description: Soft deterministic limit for open objects in one partition actor.

max_buffered_bytes.description: Soft admission limit for serialized bytes in one partition actor.

max_epoch_bytes.description:
Stable limit for serialized payload plus retained routing metadata in
one epoch. Metadata is measured as its UTF-8 lengths plus a fixed
128-byte logical overhead per row, independent of Rust's ABI. When
omitted, the limit is derived only from sink configuration, never from
in-memory delivery state.

max_in_flight_objects.description: Maximum concurrent object uploads in one partition actor.

operation_timeout.description: Deadline applied independently to each object-store request.

max_rpc_message_bytes.title: Maximum RPC message bytes
max_rpc_message_bytes.description: Maximum encoded YDB gRPC request or response accepted by setup, discovery, snapshot, and destination operations

replication.description: Configures ordinary YDB table replication from pre-created changefeeds.

changefeed_name.title: Changefeed name
changefeed_name.description: Existing FORMAT JSON, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES YDB changefeed present on every configured table

consumer_name.title: Consumer name
consumer_name.description: Existing important consumer present on every configured changefeed topic

coordination_node_path.title: Coordination node path
coordination_node_path.description: Existing YDB Coordination node used to fence this changefeed consumer globally

read_buffer_bytes.title: Read buffer bytes
read_buffer_bytes.description: YDB Topic flow-control credit granted by each replication reader

max_message_bytes.title: Maximum change record bytes
max_message_bytes.description: Maximum encoded bytes accepted for one YDB changefeed record before failing closed

max_batch_bytes.title: Maximum change batch bytes
max_batch_bytes.description: Maximum encoded bytes accepted in one YDB Topic response before failing closed

max_response_bytes.title: Maximum Topic response bytes
max_response_bytes.description: Maximum encoded gRPC response bytes accepted before YDB Topic protobuf decoding

commit_timeout_ms.title: Offset commit timeout, ms
commit_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for YDB to acknowledge source offsets after the destination commit

max_rpc_message_bytes.title: Maximum RPC message bytes
max_rpc_message_bytes.description: Maximum encoded YDB gRPC request or response accepted by setup, discovery, snapshot, and destination operations

trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.title: Trust plaintext native RPC
trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.description: Explicitly allow credentials and table data over the unencrypted YTsaurus native RPC transport

proxy_role.title: RPC proxy role
proxy_role.description: Optional dedicated RPC proxy role. Check connection loads the roles available on the selected cluster.

read_ordering.title: Read mode
read_ordering.description: Ordered reads resume at the last row after a transient failure. Unordered reads maximize single-stream throughput but fail on interruption. PartitionTables performs concurrent distributed reads and is also non-resumable.

benchmark_discard.description:
Explicit benchmark-only mode that counts wire rows without materializing
their values as Arrow arrays. Delivery semantics only permit this mode
with the discard destination.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute YTsaurus table path. The final path component is used as the logical dataset name.

trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.title: Trust plaintext native RPC
trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.description: Explicitly allow credentials and table data over the unencrypted YTsaurus native RPC transport

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory where dataset tables are stored

proxy_role.title: RPC proxy role
proxy_role.description: Optional dedicated RPC proxy role. Static-table HTTP writes do not use it, but keeping the selection here preserves it when switching table modes.

primary_key_semantics.title: Primary key semantics
primary_key_semantics.description: For schemas with primary keys, the default stages the snapshot, sorts it by the key and fails on duplicates. Preserve every row keeps the unsorted append semantics.

primary_medium.title: Primary medium
primary_medium.description: YT storage medium used for newly created tables. The default value selects the cluster's default medium.

table_attributes.title: Table attributes
table_attributes.description: Additional attributes for every newly created table. Structural attributes have dedicated settings and cannot be overridden here.

big_value_policy.title: Oversized values
big_value_policy.description: Fail preserves every source row. Drop explicitly acknowledges and discards an entire row if a value or the row exceeds YTsaurus storage limits.

optimize_for.title: Optimize for
optimize_for.description: Physical layout for newly written static-table chunks

spec.title: YT Spec
spec.description: Additional YT table_writer parameters. Explicit entries override Transferia's writer defaults.

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory where dataset tables are stored

proxy_role.title: RPC proxy role
proxy_role.description: Optional dedicated RPC proxy role used for dynamic-table writes. Check connection loads the roles available on the selected cluster.

primary_key_semantics.title: Primary key semantics
primary_key_semantics.description: Dynamic tables require one row per primary key.

primary_medium.title: Primary medium
primary_medium.description: YT storage medium used for newly created tables. The default value selects the cluster's default medium.

table_attributes.title: Table attributes
table_attributes.description: Additional attributes for every newly created table. Structural attributes have dedicated settings and cannot be overridden here.

big_value_policy.title: Oversized values
big_value_policy.description: Fail preserves every source row. Drop explicitly acknowledges and discards an entire row if a value or the row exceeds YTsaurus storage limits.

snapshot_mode.title: Batch snapshot delivery
snapshot_mode.description: Static staging writes the complete finite snapshot efficiently, verifies primary-key uniqueness, sorts it and converts it into a dynamic table before committing source progress

atomicity.title: Atomicity
atomicity.description: Full provides all-or-nothing tablet transactions. None weakens atomicity explicitly and may expose a partial write if a multi-row transaction fails.

tablet_cell_bundle.title: Tablet cell bundle
tablet_cell_bundle.description: Optional bundle used when Transferia creates the dynamic table

initial_tablet_count.title: Initial tablet count
initial_tablet_count.description: Number of tablets created before the table is mounted. Values above one require an integral first primary-key column so YTsaurus can derive lossless uniform pivot keys.

table_ttl_ms.title: Table TTL
table_ttl_ms.description: Delete dynamic-table rows after the configured duration. Months are exactly 30 days and years are exactly 365 days. Disabled by default so data is never expired implicitly.

value.title: YSON value
value.description: Exact text YSON representation of the YT attribute value

operation_pool.title: Sort/merge operation pool
operation_pool.description: Optional YTsaurus scheduler pool used only for the snapshot sort operation

transaction_rows.title: Rows per tablet transaction
transaction_rows.description: Maximum rows committed by one lossless tablet transaction

transaction_concurrency.title: Concurrent tablet transactions
transaction_concurrency.description: Maximum number of independent synchronous tablet transactions in flight

buffer_bytes.title: Dynamic write buffer bytes
buffer_bytes.description: Maximum Arrow bytes accumulated before a dynamic-table flush

dynamic_store_overflow_threshold.title: Dynamic store overflow threshold
dynamic_store_overflow_threshold.description: Flush threshold installed on dynamic tables created by Transferia; lower values leave the tablet node more headroom for sustained writes

require_sync_replica.title: Require a synchronous replica
require_sync_replica.description: Fail writes to replicated tables unless at least one synchronous replica participates

start_row.description:
First generated row identifier. This is useful when independently
generated ranges are later concatenated without duplicating primary-key
values.
